targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost),2) as value FROM charges WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost),2) as value FROM charges WHERE cost IS NOT NULL

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(distance_km) FROM trips) * $fuel_price_km, 2) as value
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(distance_km) FROM trips) * $fuel_price_km, 2) as value

targets.queryText:
WITH periodic AS (
  SELECT strftime('$period', started_at) AS period_start, SUM(t.distance_km) AS km
  FROM trips t GROUP BY 1
),
cost_periodic AS (
  SELECT strftime('$period', c.started_at) AS period_start, SUM(c.cost) AS cost
  FROM charges c WHERE c.cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
),
merged AS (
  SELECT p.period_start, COALESCE(p.km,0) as km, COALESCE(cp.cost,0) as cost
  FROM periodic p LEFT JOIN cost_periodic cp ON cp.period_start = p.period_start
),
cum AS (
  SELECT period_start, km, cost,
    SUM(km) OVER (ORDER BY period_start) as cum_km,
    SUM(cost) OVER (ORDER BY period_start) as cum_cost
  FROM merged
)
SELECT ROUND(cum_km * $fuel_price_km - cum_cost, 2) as value FROM cum ORDER BY period_start DESC LIMIT 1

WITH periodic AS (
  SELECT strftime('$period', started_at) AS period_start, SUM(t.distance_km) AS km
  FROM trips t GROUP BY 1
),
cost_periodic AS (
  SELECT strftime('$period', c.started_at) AS period_start, SUM(c.cost) AS cost
  FROM charges c WHERE c.cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
),
merged AS (
  SELECT p.period_start, COALESCE(p.km,0) as km, COALESCE(cp.cost,0) as cost
  FROM periodic p LEFT JOIN cost_periodic cp ON cp.period_start = p.period_start
),
cum AS (
  SELECT period_start, km, cost,
    SUM(km) OVER (ORDER BY period_start) as cum_km,
    SUM(cost) OVER (ORDER BY period_start) as cum_cost

SELECT period_start as Periodo,
  ROUND(cum_km * $fuel_price_km - cum_cost, 2) as "Risparmio cumulato (€)",

FROM cum ORDER BY period_start
